propositions: Scanner integration tests skip when Gitleaks and Semgrep binaries are absent; Verified does not install them despite Docker.reviewbot treating them as runtime prerequisites.
Gitleaks and Semgrep versions must be pinned separately for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 platforms due to different deployment targets (Graviton vs amd64).

A provisioning helper must validate platform support, verify Gitleaks SHA-256 against published checksums.txt, and install Semgrep only from a fully resolved per-platform requirements lock using pip --require-hashes.

A native-binary Make target must fail fast for unsupported platforms, missing/wrong scanners, or bad hashes before running the nine real integration contracts; default local tests retain skip-with-reason behavior.
A reusable parallel CI workflow must be wired into vote.needs and apply the same platform-specific scanner selection to both mirror CI and Gerrit verification lanes.
Scanner lock update procedure, checksum source, per-platform bump steps, and withdrawn-asset recovery must be documented in docs/security.md.
